preflight.intro: A quick read-only check that the printer is ready to start a print.

homed.fail: Axes not homed ({axes}); a print start usually homes first

overview.title: What is the pre-print check?
overview.body: A read-only glance at whether the printer is ready to start: it never moves or changes anything, it just reports. Hard blockers turn the verdict red; warnings inform but don't block.

checks.title: What it checks
checks.body: Klipper is ready (not shut down or in error), no print is already running, and whether the axes are homed (informational, since a print start usually homes first).

klippyState.def: Klipper's own status - 'ready' means it is connected and idle; 'shutdown' or 'error' means it can't print until cleared.

homing.def: Moving each axis to its endstop so the printer knows where the toolhead is. Most print-start routines home automatically.
